notes: CONSISTENCY FIX: one-time expenses now follow the same current-month rule as every other line. THE INCONSISTENCY: for the current month the sheet values each category and EMI at 'actual + max(0, budget - actual)' — whichever is larger, what has been spent or what was budgeted — on the reasoning that budgeted money not yet spent is still going out before the month ends. One-time expenses were the single exception: they contributed only what had actually been spent, so planned one-off spending still to come was invisible in Total Expenses and Net Surplus. On real data this understated October by Rs 89,756 (Rs 24,244 spent against Rs 1,14,000 planned across a Diwali trip and a life term premium), showing a surplus of Rs 65,199 where the honest figure was negative. A column that values ten lines one way and the eleventh another cannot be reconciled by the person reading it. NOW: current month one-time = actual + max(0, planned - actual), identical to categories and EMIs. Verified on a reproduction — Total Expenses Rs 1,67,557 + Rs 1,14,000 = Rs 2,81,557, Net Surplus Rs 262,000 - Rs 2,81,557 = -Rs 19,557, every line in the column now on the same basis. PAST MONTHS ARE UNCHANGED AND SELF-CORRECTING: a closed month takes actuals only, so an unspent plan is released rather than carried. Verified — a month planned at Rs 1,14,000 with Rs 24,244 spent reports Rs 24,244 once it closes, and the Rs 89,756 underspend simply never happened. The following month opens on the balance that actually resulted. THE CASH CHAIN IS UNAFFECTED, by design and confirmed by measurement: identical savings figures before and after this change (Rs 7,74,600 / Rs 8,38,079 / Rs 9,01,765). Current-month end-of-month savings has been live-anchored since v2026.05.05.15, so it tracks the money actually in the account, while Total Expenses and Net Surplus express what the month is still expected to cost. Planning view and cash reality stay separate and both stay correct; when planned money does leave, the live balance moves on its own. BUILDS ON v2026.05.07.01 (stable one-off ids, the journal's 'Counts towards' picker, actual-of-planned on the projection sheet, and the repeating-one-off double-count fix) and v2026.05.07.02 (per-plan budget tubes on the Budget page). Engine, runProjection, the live-anchored EOM savings fix and the Decisions tab remain untouched. No page errors across Dashboard, Budget, Budget-actuals, Instruments, Rates and Decisions.
